title: Word Streak Duels
oneLiner: 60-second daily word ladder — beat your best, keep your streak, share your score.
inspiredBy: Words With Friends-style social word play
The Facebook Instant Game of the same name
targetAudience: Casual Android players 18–44 who want a 2–4 minute word break. Same loop as the Instant Game, native Play install, AdMob rewarded freeze.

pillars.coreLoop: See seed → chain words in 60s (last letter rule) → beat personal best
pillars.social: Share score via Android share sheet; Play Games leaderboards optional later
pillars.retention: Daily ladder seed + streak freeze (rewarded ad) + weekly themed packs
pillars.monetization: AdMob rewarded for hint / streak freeze; optional Play Billing cosmetics later
pillars.discovery: 512 icon of gold letter tiles; 1024×500 feature graphic of a word chain race
pillars.liveOps: Theme weeks, limited ladders, seasonal dictionaries
